page.overview:
What is Organium Group?

The Organium Group was an organization that operated during the time of the New Republic. In 19 ABY, an outpost of the Organium Group of a remote world fell under attack from a band of Tempest addicts, who set fire to a number of the Group's warehouses and factories, and a group of freelance agents were dispatched to the world to restore order.
